hosts.enableProxmoxStatsDesc: Show a Proxmox Stats tab for this host with live node, guest, storage, and cluster stats collected over SSH.
hosts.proxmoxStatsPollIntervalDesc: Minimum 15 seconds. How often to refresh Proxmox node stats.
hosts.proxmoxStatsNodeOverrideDesc: Override auto-detection of the Proxmox node name (detected via hostname by default).
hosts.enableProxmoxDesc: Mark this host as a Proxmox node. Enables guest discovery and import directly from this host.
hosts.proxmoxDefaultAuthTypeDesc: Authentication method applied to imported guest hosts. Choose the auth type that matches how you connect to your guests.
hosts.proxmoxDefaultCredentialDesc: Credential used for imported guest hosts when auth type is set to Credential.
hosts.proxmoxWindowsDetectionDesc: Comma-separated name patterns that trigger RDP instead of SSH (case-insensitive)
hosts.proxmoxDockerDetectionDesc: Comma-separated name patterns that enable Docker for matching guests
hosts.proxmoxPreferredRangesDesc: Comma-separated prefixes in priority order for IP selection when a guest has multiple interfaces
hosts.proxmoxAutoSyncDesc: Periodically discover this Proxmox node and create or update imported guest hosts while your session is unlocked.
hosts.proxmoxSyncIntervalDesc: Minimum 5 minutes. The scheduler skips locked user sessions.
hosts.proxmoxMarkMissingDesc: Add a proxmox-missing tag when a previously imported guest disappears instead of deleting it.
hosts.proxmoxNoGuests: No guests found on this Proxmox node.
hosts.proxmoxTransportDesc: How Termix reads this node for discovery, sync and stats: pvesh over SSH, or the Proxmox REST API with an API token.
hosts.proxmoxApiUrlDesc: Where the API answers, usually https://<node>:8006. Termix must reach it directly; jump hosts are not used for the API.
hosts.proxmoxApiTokenIdDesc: In the form user@realm!tokenid. The token only needs read access.
hosts.proxmoxApiTokenSecretDesc: Stored encrypted and never sent back to the browser. Only the host's owner can change it.
hosts.proxmoxApiTlsDesc: Trust only the cluster's own CA, the server's trust store, or nothing.
hosts.proxmoxApiTlsInsecureWarning: The certificate is not checked, so anyone on the network path could read the API token.
hosts.proxmoxApiCaPemDesc: Paste /etc/pve/pve-root-ca.pem from any node of the cluster.

plugin.name: Proxmox
plugin.description: Import Proxmox VE guests as hosts, keep them in sync and watch node stats.
